## [1.3.1] - Boss size, config checking and domain fixes

Maintenance and bug-fix update. If something breaks or behaves differently than before, please report it on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Fi3w0/Fiw-Bosses/issues).

> **⚠ Upgrade note:** a boss or custom minion with `renderEntity` now has that mob's hitbox instead of the player-sized one (an iron golem disguise is 1.4 x 2.7). Spawns are lifted up to 3 blocks or refused when the boss does not fit. Update client and server together.
>
> **⚠ Upgrade note:** domains with custom attacks could crash dedicated or singleplayer servers when their goals were replaced. Fixed on every supported loader/version.

### Added
- `scale` (0.0625-16, default 1) on bosses and custom minions resizes the model, hitbox and name tag height together, on every loader and Minecraft version. ([#3](https://github.com/Fi3w0/Fiw-Bosses/issues/3))
- `reach` (0-16 blocks, default 0) adds melee reach on top of the normal reach, for long weapons or small bosses. ([#3](https://github.com/Fi3w0/Fiw-Bosses/issues/3))
- Room check before a boss spawns from `/boss spawn`, summon items/altars and scheduled world spawns: the spawn is lifted up to 3 blocks to fit the boss's hitbox, or refused. `/boss spawn` and summon items say how much open space the boss needs (the summon item is not used up); schedules log a warning and skip that spawn.
- `/boss validate` (op level 3) lists every config problem with its file and field: misspelled keys with a "did you mean" hint, unknown ability types (also inside domain `attacks` and rages), out-of-range values, duplicate ids, missing minions/variants/rages and schedule mistakes.
- Configs are also checked on every load and `/boss reload`: each problem is logged, and `/boss reload` says how many it found.
- `domainBreakSound` (on/off) and `domainBreakVolume` (0-100%, default 50%) in `settings.json` control the domain collapse sound for every boss.
- Domain `attacks[]` accept `cooldownTicks` as an alias of `cooldown` on every supported target. If both are set, `cooldown` wins; the default stays 40 ticks.
- Copy-ready `examples/settings.json` with every default, and `examples/schedules/clockwork_guardian.json` with a 30-minute world spawn schedule.

### Changed
- A boss or custom minion with `renderEntity` uses that mob's hitbox instead of the player-sized one. ([#3](https://github.com/Fi3w0/Fiw-Bosses/issues/3))
- Melee reach follows body size: big bosses hit you without walking into you, and bosses smaller than 1x get proportionally shorter reach so a tiny boss can't out-reach its own hitbox.
- Shadow clones copy the boss's `scale` and `reach`; difficulty variants keep the boss's size.
- Teleport, swap and slam abilities no longer move a big boss into a spot where its hitbox would be stuck in blocks.
- Domain collapse sound: the layered ender dragon death roar is removed, the `domain_break` sound is quieter by default and carries 48 blocks.
- Config files are always read as UTF-8 (on 1.20.1 under Windows, non-English names and messages could be garbled before).

### Fixed
- Domains with custom attacks no longer crash the server when they end, are interrupted, or the boss changes phase or is reloaded mid-domain. Domain goals are restored safely, stale phase/reload actions are discarded, and the active rage overlay is kept.
- Side-strafing bosses now close into melee range instead of continuously backing away from their target.
- Local `file` skins accept a name with or without `.png`.

### Documentation
- Configuration guide: new "Size and hitbox" section, `scale`/`reach` fields, `/boss validate` and the domain sound settings.
- Corrected commands, paths, navigation, persistence notes and domain sound overrides; global settings, webhooks, pathfinding and records have their own sections.
- README and Modrinth page list `/boss validate`.

## [1.3.0] - Summon altars, variants, rages and anti-cheese

### Added
- **Summon items & altars** — new `summon` list on a boss. Players right-click with a configured
  item (vanilla `item`, optional exact `name`, or a Fiw Tools `toolId`) to start the fight,
  optionally only on an `altar` block. Per-entry `consume`, per-player `cooldownSeconds`,
  `variant` and a server-wide `message`. Example: `examples/summon/ember_warden.json`.
- **Spawn limits** — `spawnLimits.maxAlive` and a server-wide `cooldownSeconds` for player
  summons, with refusal messages telling the player why. Living bosses are counted even in
  unloaded chunks. State is saved in `config/fiw_bosses/data/spawns.json`. Admin
  `/boss spawn` is never limited.
- **Difficulty variants** — named `variants` (e.g. `hard`) with `healthMultiplier`,
  `damageMultiplier`, `meleeDamageMultiplier`, `abilityDamageMultiplier`, `lootMultiplier`, an
  optional replacement `loot` table and `displayName`. Saved with the boss.
- **Melee / ability damage multipliers** — phases gain `meleeDamageMultiplier` and
  `abilityDamageMultiplier` next to `damageMultiplier`.
- **Arena leash** — `arena.radius`: a boss pulled too far from its spawn point resets (home,
  full health, phase 1, fight ledger cleared so nobody earns loot for the abandoned attempt).
  `minionsOnReset` despawns its minions or brings them to the boss.
- **Anti-cheese** — opt-in `antiCheese.stuck` detection with admin-chosen actions
  (`teleport_to_target`, `teleport_attack`, `teleport_home`, `heal`, `reset`, `despawn`,
  `rage:<name>`) and optional per-occurrence `escalation`; bosses and custom minions destroy
  boats/minecarts they're put in (on by default, optional `vehicleRage`); opt-in
  `ignoreSlowBlocks` (cobweb, powder snow, berry bush, honey, soul sand...) with per-block
  overrides. Custom minions that can't reach their target teleport to it
  (`teleportWhenStuck`, on by default). Bosses still never break blocks.
- **Rages & enrage timer** — named `rages` that override the current HP phase while active
  (abilities, multipliers, gear, protection, messages) plus `durationSeconds`,
  `extraHealthPercent`, `healPercent` and `bossBarColor`. Triggered by stuck actions, vehicles,
  or automatically `afterSeconds` into the fight. Saved through restarts. Example:
  `examples/anticheese/rift_sentinel.json`.
- **Loot lockout** — `rewards.lockoutHours`: a player who earned rewards from a boss gets no
  per-player loot or reward commands from it until the lockout ends (still listed in the
  summary, and told how long is left). `lockoutPerVariant` chooses one shared lockout or one
  per variant. Saved in `config/fiw_bosses/data/lockouts.json`.
- **Kill records** — total kills, fastest kill and its party, top single-fight damage and
  kills per player, in `config/fiw_bosses/data/records.json`. `/boss stats [bossId]`.
- **Discord kill webhooks** — `settings.json` `webhooks.discord` (or a boss's own `webhook`,
  or `"enabled": false`) posts an embed on every rewarded kill: killer, fight time, variant,
  top damage, unique drops, new-record footer. Sent off the server thread, no retries.
- **Shield phase (pylons)** — a phase or rage `shield` summons `count` pylons (any custom
  minion) in a ring; the boss takes no damage until all are destroyed, and the boss bar shows
  how many are left. Example: `examples/anticheese/minions/rift_pylon.json`.
- **Selectable path finding** — `pathfinding` in settings.json (default `"vanilla"`, unchanged)
  or per boss/minion. `"shared"` lets squads chasing the same target share one path search and
  re-plans less often for far targets — a big saving for large minion swarms.
- **Scheduled world spawns** — `schedules` in settings.json or a boss file's `schedule`:
  every `intervalMinutes` or at daily `times`, random pick from `locations`, server-wide
  countdown broadcasts, at most one live boss per schedule. Validated on reload (exactly one

## [1.2.1] - Performance fixes

### Fixed
- **Boss bar network spam** — every boss cleared and re-added its boss bar for every nearby player
  on every tick (about 40 packets per second per player, and the client rebuilt the bar each time).
  The bar now only adds players who come into range and removes those who leave, checked every
  10 ticks. Health and title updates are still instant.
- **Idle-timeout player search** — bosses with `idleTimeout` searched the world for nearby players
  every tick. They now check every second.
- **Fight tracking** — damage taken and deaths for raid rewards and the fight summary are now
  sampled every 5 ticks instead of every tick. Results are the same; deaths on servers with
  instant respawn are still counted.

releases.notes:
## [1.2.0] - Raid rewards, fight summary, uncapped health

### Added
- **Raid rewards** — new optional `rewards` block. `"lootMode": "per_player"` gives every eligible
  player their own roll of the loot table, delivered straight to their inventory (overflow drops at
  their feet and only they can pick it up). Eligibility needs `minDamagePercent` of the boss's max
  health dealt, so leechers get nothing.
  - `"unique": true` loot entries roll once and go to exactly one raider — never duplicated. Ideal
    for one-of-a-kind Fiw Tools weapons (`toolId`).
  - `damageLuck` (per boss or per entry) makes bigger contributors luckier; `maxChance` caps it.
  - `topRanks` limits an entry to the top N damage dealers.
  - `commands`, `participantCommands` and `mvpCommands` with `{boss}` `{killer}` `{mvp}`
    `{player}` `{damage}` `{percent}` `{rank}` `{participants}` `{x}` `{y}` `{z}` placeholders.
- **Fight summary** — optional chat recap on death: killing blow, top damage with share %, most
  damage taken, who fell, unique drops and fight time. Only players who actually engaged the boss
  are listed. Global defaults in the new `config/fiw_bosses/settings.json`, per-boss overrides via
  a `fightSummary` block, and live toggles with `/boss summary on|off|top|show`.
- **`/boss phase <targets> next|prev|set <n>`** — move a live boss to another phase without
  touching its HP. HP thresholds it already passed won't pull it back.
- **Fiw Tools phase hooks** — phase changes are reported to Fiw Tools (its new `on_boss_phase`
  trigger), and a public `FiwBossesAPI` lets its `boss_phase` admin ability change phases.
- **Real HP on the boss bar** — `bossBar.showHealth` (or the global `showBossBarHealth` in
  `settings.json`) appends the HP to the bar title, e.g. `1,500/1,500 ❤`.
- Example raid boss: `examples/raid/raid_titan.json`.

### Fixed
- **`/boss kill` and `/kill` could fail to kill a boss.** Admin kills went through the boss's damage
  handling, so an armed `second_wind` or `preDeathDialogue` swallowed them (and `/boss kill` still
  reported success). Generic-kill damage now bypasses immunity states, protection, Second Wind and
  the pre-death hold.
- **`second_wind` re-armed instantly after saving the boss** when it had been armed longer than its
  `cooldownTicks`. The re-arm cooldown now starts when the revive is spent, as documented.
- **Boss/minion `health` above 1024 no longer gets silently capped.** Vanilla clamps max health to
  1024; bosses and custom minions now really have their configured HP (a 60,000 HP boss has 60,000
  HP), and Jade / WTHIT / The One Probe show the true value. The global attribute cap is untouched.
  Vanilla-base minions are still real vanilla mobs and stay capped.
- **Bosses near spawn were deleted on every NeoForge/Forge restart.** Configs loaded after spawn and
  force-loaded chunks had already loaded their entities, so those bosses were removed as
  "definition not found". Configs now load before the worlds.
- **A boss's phase wasn't restored after a restart** (it re-entered phase 1 and then re-advanced by
  HP, losing admin-forced phases). The saved phase is now restored.
- **Disguised bosses/minions (`renderEntity`) glided without walking or attack animations** on
  1.21.1 and 1.20.1. The disguise model now plays the boss's real walk cycle and arm swing.
- **A boss that died right before a save came back at full health** after the restart. It now stays
  dead.

### Notes
- Issue #2 (PMMO crash naming `EarthShatterEntity`): that entity belongs to the separate
  *FD Bosses* mod, not FIW Bosses. FIW Bosses' entities register full attribute suppliers and are
  handled by PMMO's scan normally.
- `/boss kill` never grants raid rewards, commands or a summary; in the default `shared` loot mode
  the ground drop still happens as before.
- All features are available on every supported version and loader (1.21.11, 1.21.8, 1.21.1,
  1.20.1 — Fabric, NeoForge, Forge).

## [1.1.3]

### Added
- **`wind_charge` boss/minion ability** — leaps toward the target and slams down on landing
  (no fall damage to the boss itself). This is a fully custom, config-driven mace-style
  jump-slam: `damage`, `radius`, `knockback`, `launchPower`, `jumpPower`, `horizontalSpeed`,
  `minRange`/`maxRange`, and an optional `fallDamagePerBlock` (capped by `maxFallBonus`) for a
  vanilla-flavored fall-scaling bonus — entirely independent of whatever is actually equipped.
  A boss can visibly wield a `minecraft:mace` and still hit for 1 damage here, or the reverse.
  See `BOSS_CONFIG_DOCS.md` for the full param table.
- **Note on real maces:** equipping `"minecraft:mace"` in `equipment.mainHand` already gives any
  boss/minion the authentic vanilla smash-attack mechanic for free (mobs holding a mace get it
  automatically, same as players) — no new code was needed for that. `wind_charge` is the
  separate, tunable alternative; the two can be combined or used independently.
- On 1.20.1 (pre-1.21, no mace item or Gust particles), `wind_charge` behaves identically —
  jump/slam/knockback are entirely our own code — with period-appropriate particles/sounds.

### Fixed
- `/boss minion spawn` used to reject any minion definition with a non-`"custom"` `baseEntity`
  ("uses a vanilla base entity — spawn it via a boss with summon_minions"), even though the identical
  definition worked fine when dropped in the `bosses/` folder and spawned with `/boss spawn`. Vanilla-base
  minions can now be spawned directly by command — the same stat/equipment-override logic
  `summon_minions` already used is now shared by the command path.
- Damage protection (`protection` maps) is now applied before adaptation tracking records the hit,
  so fully-blocked damage is never recorded and partial protection is reflected in what adaptation
  actually resists.

### Notes
- All features are available on every supported version and loader (1.21.11, 1.21.8, 1.21.1, 1.20.1 —
  Fabric, NeoForge, Forge).
